description: Autoroutes cyclables is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vereniging van Vlaamse Provincies. This dataset contains information about the bicycle highways on the territory of the Flemish Region. It is a bundling of the data managed by the 5 provinces, so that the data is offered on an area-wide basis. Coverage: Vereniging van Vlaamse Provincies. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle highways" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vereniging van Vlaamse Provincies. Its keywords include FSW, Fietsostrades. The listing shows 2022-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
